question: Which country is regarded as the origin of SUMO Wrestling game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sumo is a form of competitive full-contact** wrestling where a rikishi attempts to force his opponent out of a circular ring or touch the ground**.
 
• Sumo word refers to the **Modern martial art form**.
 
• Sumo is the** national sport **of **Japan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****__ About Japan__**

__
 
• Japan is called the **"Land of Rising Sun"**.
 
• Japan is a amalgation of four island** (Honshu, Hokkaido, Shikoku and Kyushu)**.
 
• Japan is surrounded by the** Pacific Ring of Fire**, which is affected by **earthquakes, volcanoes and tsunamis**.
 
• Recently in **July 2022 Sakurajima volcano** of Kyushu island of Japan erupted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
